business.description: PFL Infotech Limited is a listed company that was acquired by new promoters in December 2024. The company is proposing to restructure and diversify its business activities.

outlook.statement: The new promoters propose to raise funds and expand the company's business activities or diversify the line of business. They also intend to keep the listing status alive and ensure the company performs well in terms of turnover and profitability year-on-year.
The company is still in the process of selecting a business which can contribute to the profitability of the company and add value to the stakeholders.

risks: Investors/financial agencies shy away from extending support due to accumulated losses not represented by assets
Present financial statements do not represent true financial status for raising funds
Since the company is carrying on only trading operations it does not perceive any threats, risks and concerns for its business.
Company has incurred cash losses in current financial year (Rs. -48.91 lakhs) and immediately preceding financial year (Rs. -34.70 lakhs)
Outstanding income tax demands for FY 2015-16 (Rs. 7.32 lakhs), FY 2017-18 (Rs. 13.58 lakhs), and FY 2020-21 (Rs. 4.03 lakhs) remain unpaid
Secretarial auditor noted non-payment of Income Tax for financial years 2015-16, 2017-18, and 2020-21
Market risk comprising interest rate risk and other price risk such as equity price risk and commodity/real estate risk
Credit risk arising from trade receivables and deposits with banks/financial institutions
Liquidity risk managed through bank deposits and loans
